// diagnostic

E2604

Integrity check failed for `{package}` `{version}` — expected `{expected}`, got `{actual}`.

What

Integrity check failed for `{package}` `{version}` — expected `{expected}`, got `{actual}`.

Why

A fetched artifact's content hash differs from what the lockfile recorded. This means the artifact changed after it was locked — accidental or deliberate tampering.

Fix

Re-run `jet fetch` after cleaning stale Jetpack hangar entries (`jet clean`). If the problem persists, the upstream source may have been altered; audit the change before proceeding.
